def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(r.count(v) for r in grid))
    # Grid lines are the rows/columns that are almost entirely one color.
    hr = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    vc = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    # Use full-width/full-height separator lines as lattice boundaries.
    hr = [r for r in hr if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    vc = [c for c in vc if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    out = [[bg for _ in range(len(vc)-1)] for _ in range(len(hr)-1)]
    for i in range(len(hr)-1):
        for j in range(len(vc)-1):
            vals = [grid[r][c] for r, c in (
                (hr[i], vc[j]), (hr[i], vc[j+1]),
                (hr[i+1], vc[j]), (hr[i+1], vc[j+1]))]
            special = [v for v in vals if v not in (bg,)]
            if len(special) == 4 and len(set(special)) == 1:
                out[i][j] = special[0]
    return out
